Name: Statue of Generosity
Author: spacechase0
Description:
[b]Statue of Generosity[/b] adds a statue which produces a loved gift each morning.

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Use[/size][/b]
You can buy Statues of Generosity from Krobus for 100,000g. Each day it will produce a loved gift for the villager whose birthday it is today, or for a random villager if there's no birthday.

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.

[/list]
